sections: What WhitePact offers

WhitePact is an open-source trust and runtime governance platform for AI agents, with paid cloud and enterprise software/services for production deployment. These are digital products and services; no physical goods are sold.
Community / Open Source — Free

Use the MIT-licensed software for local and self-hosted governance, including policy evaluation and governance evidence capabilities. Local/community development does not require WhitePact activation. You operate your infrastructure and remain responsible for its configuration. Community support is available through the project repository.
WhitePact Cloud / Pro — Contact for current pricing

Discuss hosted access, production API credentials and managed capabilities. Commercial availability, included capabilities, usage allowances, billing currency and recurring charges are confirmed in an order or checkout before purchase. A contact inquiry does not create a paid subscription. Self-service paid checkout is available only when production billing is configured.
Enterprise / Private Deployment — Contact for current pricing

Discuss private deployment, identity-provider integration and software support services. Deliverables, implementation scope and any support commitments are defined in a written agreement. No uptime guarantee, response-time commitment or certification is implied by this page.
Official production deployment identity — Planned

Signed official deployment identity is being integrated and is not offered as an available purchase entitlement today. It is distinct from customer authority and does not replace your organization's governance controls. Community use does not depend on this planned commercial capability.
Before you purchase

Request a written quote using the contact link below. Review the agreed features, total price, taxes, billing period, renewal and cancellation terms before accepting. Subscription cancellation and refund requests are explained in the Refund Policy. Buying a plan never grants permission to bypass governance.

sections: Acceptance and scope

These terms apply to the WhitePact website and WhitePact-provided accounts, hosted software and services. WhitePact is the project and service brand referred to as we or us here. By using these services, you agree to these terms. If acting for an organization, you must have permission to accept them. A separately agreed written order governs its specific commercial deliverables.
Software and community use

WhitePact provides trust and runtime governance software for AI agents and related cloud and enterprise software services. The open-source Community code is licensed separately under the MIT License. These website terms do not remove rights granted by that license. Local/community development requires no mandatory WhitePact activation. Self-hosted operators control and are responsible for their own infrastructure and configuration.
Accounts and credentials

Provide accurate account information, protect credentials and use only accounts and organizations you are authorized to access. Notify us of suspected misuse. API-key secrets are disclosed at creation or rotation and cannot be retrieved afterward. You remain responsible for configuring appropriate permissions and reviewing agent actions.
Acceptable use

Do not use the services unlawfully, infringe others' rights, access systems or data without authorization, distribute malware, commit fraud or evade security controls. Security testing must stay within systems you own or have permission to assess. Do not submit data you lack permission to process.
Subscriptions and billing

Any paid order or checkout must identify the service, price, currency, billing period, applicable taxes and renewal terms before purchase. Recurring billing applies only as agreed when subscribing. Payments may be handled by a payment processor or merchant-of-record/billing provider identified at checkout; its applicable purchase terms also apply. WhitePact does not store raw payment-card details. A failed payment may restrict paid hosted services, but does not grant additional governance authority.
Cancellation and refunds

Cancel recurring service through the available billing portal or contact us using the details below if you cannot access it. Cancellation stops future renewal once processed under the applicable order terms; it does not itself refund a completed billing period. Refund requests, duplicate charges, billing errors and paid-service access issues are addressed in the Refund Policy linked below. Mandatory consumer rights remain unaffected.
Intellectual property and customer data

You retain rights in the data you submit. You permit the processing necessary to provide the services you request. WhitePact branding and non-open-source service materials remain protected by applicable intellectual-property law. The MIT License and third-party open-source licenses govern the code to which they apply.
Third-party services

Your configured identity providers, model providers, integrations and billing services may have their own terms and privacy practices. Review them before enabling a connection. You are responsible for having permission to send data to an integration. Third-party availability is not controlled by WhitePact.
Availability and disclaimers

Services may be interrupted for maintenance, outages or security reasons. No guaranteed uptime or support response time applies unless expressly agreed in writing. To the extent permitted by applicable law, the services are provided as available without a promise that they are error-free or suitable for every purpose. Governance outputs are not legal advice, certification or a guarantee of safe or lawful agent behavior; human oversight remains necessary.
Liability and protected rights

To the extent permitted by applicable law, WhitePact is not responsible for indirect or consequential loss arising from service use. Nothing in these terms excludes or limits liability that cannot lawfully be excluded or limited, or removes mandatory consumer remedies. Any separately negotiated allocation of liability applies only as permitted by law. No monetary liability cap is introduced by this page.
Suspension and termination

You may stop using the website and request account closure through our contact address. Subscription cancellation and lawful record-retention requirements still apply. We may restrict or terminate hosted access for unlawful use, security threats or material breach, with notice where practicable. This does not revoke rights already granted under the MIT License.
Changes and contact

privacy.title: Privacy Policy | WhitePact
privacy.heading: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: How WhitePact handles account information, billing metadata, security events and submitted data, including self-hosted privacy boundaries.
sections: Scope and contact

This policy describes data handling for the WhitePact website and services operated by WhitePact. For privacy questions or requests, contact annaduraiguruprasath7@gmail.com. Your organization may separately control data processed for its workspace and determine the purpose of that processing.
Account and authentication data

Hosted accounts may include your name, email address, organization and membership information, password verifier, session records and verification or password-reset records. We use these to authenticate users, manage access and communicate about accounts. API-key metadata includes identifiers, names, roles, verifier hashes, creation and usage information, rather than recoverable raw API-key secrets.
Billing and support information

When commercial billing is enabled, we process customer and subscription references, plan and payment-status metadata, billing events and information you provide for support. The billing provider identified at checkout handles payment details under its own privacy terms. The current billing integration uses Stripe; other providers may be identified for a future purchase. WhitePact does not store raw payment-card details.
Submitted content and security events

Hosted features may process content you submit for evaluation, resulting decisions and evidence, and operational or security records such as request timing, status and authentication events. Configured logging may include network identifiers. Submit only information necessary for your use case and which you are authorized to share. Public registry or incident submissions are intended for publication as described by those features; do not include confidential information in public submissions.
Purposes and sharing

We use information to provide requested functionality, protect accounts and organizations, investigate abuse, support users, administer billing and meet applicable legal obligations. We do not sell personal data or use submitted content to train our own models. Customer-selected model and integration providers receive data only through the features and connections used or configured by the customer.
Self-hosted deployments

Running Community or self-hosted software does not automatically send all agent activity, prompts or evidence to WhitePact. Your organization controls its infrastructure, database, secrets, telemetry configuration and enabled integrations. Data reaches WhitePact or another provider when you choose a hosted service, contact support or configure an integration that sends it. Direct requests concerning wholly self-hosted data to the organization operating that deployment.
Cookies and telemetry

The dashboard uses necessary authentication-session and CSRF cookies. The current public website does not include advertising or cross-site tracking. Operational telemetry depends on the service and deployment configuration; self-hosted operators control their own telemetry destinations. Disabling necessary cookies can prevent account functions from working.
Service providers

Hosted operation may use configured hosting, database, cache, email-delivery, identity and billing providers. Repository deployment configurations include Render, Supabase and Upstash; which providers process a particular deployment's data depends on its configuration. Customers can use their own identity and integration providers. Request current provider and processing details for a proposed hosted service before sending sensitive data. We may disclose information where legally required or necessary to address security threats.
Retention

We retain information for service delivery, account administration, security, dispute resolution and applicable legal or accounting requirements. Retention depends on the data category, deployment configuration and agreed terms. Closing an account does not immediately erase records that must be retained by law or for legitimate security purposes. Automated deletion is not guaranteed for every data category; contact us to discuss deletion or retention requirements before relying on a specific period.
Security and international processing

Controls include credential-verifier storage, access restrictions and secure-transport configuration; encryption and other protections depend on the deployment and feature configuration. No system is risk-free, and this policy is not a certification claim. Providers may process data in different countries. Ask for current processing locations and applicable transfer arrangements before purchasing a service with residency requirements.
Your rights

Subject to applicable law, you may request access, correction, deletion, restriction or portability of personal data, object to relevant processing, or withdraw consent where processing relies on it. Contact our privacy address; we may verify identity and workspace authority before acting. We respond under applicable legal requirements, and some records may be retained where legally permitted or required. You may raise concerns with the relevant data-protection authority.
Children and policy updates

WhitePact services are intended for adult users and organizational use, not children. Contact us if you believe a child has submitted personal information. We will update this page when practices change and provide additional notice where required by applicable law.

sections: Scope

This policy applies to paid WhitePact digital software and services. Free Community software has no purchase charge to refund. Your purchase terms and any applicable merchant-of-record terms also apply; nothing here limits rights required by applicable law.
Subscription cancellation

Use the billing portal available from your account to cancel recurring billing. If the portal is unavailable or you cannot access your account, email annaduraiguruprasath7@gmail.com for cancellation assistance. Cancellation stops future renewals once processed in accordance with your purchase terms. It does not automatically refund a completed billing period. Access for the remainder of a paid period follows the terms of your order.
Refund review

Contact us about duplicate charges, accidental duplicate purchases, proven billing errors or inability to access a paid service attributable to WhitePact. We review the transaction and service circumstances and arrange an appropriate correction or refund where warranted or required by law. Refund requests are reviewed in accordance with the circumstances of the purchase, the applicable subscription terms, and rights required by applicable law.
How to request a refund

Email annaduraiguruprasath7@gmail.com with the subject WhitePact refund request. Include the account email, order or invoice reference, purchase date and a description of the issue. Never send passwords, API keys or full card details. If a merchant of record handled your purchase, you may also use the support details on its receipt. We may request information needed to verify the transaction and will explain the outcome through your contact address.
Processing and misuse

Approved refunds are handled through the applicable billing provider, ordinarily to the original payment method; processing time depends on that provider and your financial institution. We may investigate fraudulent, abusive or materially misleading requests, without limiting valid statutory rights or remedies for genuine billing errors.
Consumer rights and agreed services

Mandatory cancellation, withdrawal and refund rights under applicable consumer law take priority over conflicting policy language. For separately agreed enterprise services, the written order describes the deliverables and any service-specific cancellation terms, subject to those rights. Contact us if you need help identifying the terms applicable to your purchase.
